digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: Overlap judge batched calls inherit generic 16,000-token, three-structured-retry, four-transport-retry, and 600-second-per-request budgets with no operation-local bounds, causing multi-minute malformed responses before safe abstention.
RunRequest lacks lowering-only seams for per-request structured-retry count, transport-attempt count, timeout, and output-token limits, forcing all callers to use generic policy.
Token-only output caps and schema validation alone are insufficient containment—malformed 40KB+ payloads still trigger multiple retries and long latencies before the advisory catch executes.

Repair applies request-local 1,024 output token, 1 structured attempt, 1 transport attempt, and 60-second timeout budgets to overlap judge calls, with timeout and transport ceilings applied before model/provider construction.
Valid batched overlap verdicts must retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior; all timeout, truncation, and malformed outcomes must degrade to exact all-candidate abstention.
Existing callers omitting request-local limits must retain current generic policy via lower-only seams in RunRequest and _effective_config.
